name: markdown-vault-mcp
description: MCP server for markdown vaults: FTS5 + semantic search, link graph, write/edit/git.

source_dir.title: Vault directory
source_dir.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. Required — the server refuses to start without it. Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault. git_sync also needs managed git mode; create_upload_link needs an HTTP transport.

exclude_patterns.title: Exclude patterns
exclude_patterns.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: Semantic-search backend: fastembed, ollama, or openai. Leave empty to disable embeddings.

ollama_host.title: Ollama host
ollama_host.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI base URL
openai_base_url.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.

git_repo_url.title: Git sync repository URL
git_repo_url.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

git_token.title: Git access token
git_token.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

server_name.title: Server name
server_name.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.
